purpose: Teach: 人体/巧妙/弔い/思春期/罪悪/文系/パトロール/搬入

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、人体、絶対、への、絶対、影響、絶対、警察、絶対、調査中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: This case is under serious investigation regarding any potential harm to the victim. We're grateful for your understanding.
lines.style: Measured and official, but not cold. Even pace. Slight weight on "serious investigation"—conviction without urgency. Professional eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、容疑者の、絶対、巧妙、絶対、な、絶対、手口、絶対、警察、絶対、解明されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the suspect's method was actually quite sophisticated. It's impressive that the police were able to work it out.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, slightly impressed. Gentle upturn at the end—not challenging, but asking for confirmation. Leans in slightly. Warm interest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、被害者の、絶対、弔い、絶対、ご遺族、絶対、警察、絶対、ご訪問、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We made a visit to the bereaved family to express our condolences regarding the victim. It was important we did so personally.
lines.style: Respectful and measured. Slower pace on "bereaved family." Quiet dignity. Not solemn, but grave. Voice carries the weight of having done something difficult but necessary.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、思春期、絶対、の、絶対、加害者、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、慎重、絶対、ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The approach to the adolescent perpetrator has been quite careful, hasn't it? That must require a lot of consideration.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Slight pause before "adolescent." Acknowledging the complexity without needing an answer. Observant rather than questioning.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、被害者の、絶対、罪悪、絶対、感、絶対、警察、絶対、ケア、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're making sure to provide care and support to the victim as they process what's happened. That's very much part of our work.
lines.style: Steady and genuine. Slower on "care and support"—it's not just procedure, it's intentional. Quiet conviction. Not defensive, just clear about priorities.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、文系、絶対、出身の、絶対、捜査官、絶対、警察、絶対、活躍、絶対、されているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I see you have investigators with humanities backgrounds on the case—that's actually quite valuable for this kind of work.
lines.style: Appreciative observation. Soft, admiring tone. Not flattery—genuine recognition of good work. Slight nod in the voice. Conversational ease.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、夜間、絶対、パトロール、絶対、強化、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've increased our nighttime patrols in the area to ensure community safety going forward.
lines.style: Direct and calm. Even emphasis across the statement. No dramatizing—just facts delivered with quiet assurance. Professional certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、押収品、絶対、搬入、絶対、警察、絶対、完了、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The seized evidence has all been transported and catalogued. The documentation is complete.
lines.style: Final statement, slightly quieter. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive. Slight exhale of completion at the end. Careful, methodical tone throughout.
